invariants.rationale: The method returns 'this', which is the current Cell<T> instance, so the result should never be null.
The method sets expandY to onei, which is presumably defined as 1, so the invariant should hold if onei == 1.
The method sets fillY to onef, which is presumably defined as 1f, so the invariant should hold if onef == 1f.
The method literally returns 'this', so the result must equal this.
